Refund Policy

At Escape Clothing, customer satisfaction is our priority.

Return Window

7 days from date of delivery.

Eligibility

  • Product must be unused, unwashed, with original tags attached
  • Damaged or defective products are eligible for refund or exchange
  • Sale items may have different return terms

Refund Method

Refunds are processed to the original payment method within 5-7 business days after we receive and inspect the returned item.

Exchange

Exchanges are available for size/fit issues subject to stock availability.
